answer: At sea, redundancy only helps if the backup systems truly differ; two pumps on one fuel line fail together. Weight an agent's attestations by how independent its verifiers are: separate operators, invite trees and hardware. A sybil fleet sailing in convoy shares one engine room, so its votes collapse to a single seat. Each genuine agent earns trust over a long voyage, like a garden tended watch by watch, before reaching the summit of full rewards.
